R1.description: The read-only report: python3 scripts/workflow_retention.py report [--json] lists the finished work items by the rule of docs/RETENTION.md (phase MILESTONE_COMPLETE for the item, its parent and its children, a fresh query saying merged, not the 3 newest, never an open item) with, for each, the size of its untracked .ai-review/<id>/ folder and whether an archive exists at <archive-root>/<repo>/<id>.tar.zst and is older than the TTL (default 30 days, a flag) and so prunable; JSON for the Manager and the Controller plus a text form

R2.description: The report writes nothing: no archive, no removal, no state write, no stored fact, no bytecode; the repository tree and the archive directory are byte-identical before and after a run, proved by a test and a functional flow

R3.description: A failed or empty query means not finished and an open item is never queried: forge errors, an unexpected exception, no pull request, open or closed, a missing anchor and an open parent or child each put the item in not_finished with a reason, and one failure does not stop the report

R4.description: Documents and roadmap: docs/RETENTION.md gets the section The report and corrected references to rows 27b, 27c and 27d, docs/exit-codes.md gets the script rows, and docs/ROADMAP.md carries the split rows 27b (report, Current), 27c (archive command) and 27d (prune)

R5.description: One mechanism, no protocol or state change: payload changes are the new script and its tests in an existing suite, plus the release constant; no protocol operation, state key, phase, trailer, command file or WORKFLOW_CONFIG key is added, and no tenth conformance suite

R6.description: Release 2.20.0, a feat minor: WORKFLOW_RELEASE and its pinned assertions, the added scripts/workflow_retention.py record (counts 81 and 6), changed digests and sizes with a retention-report sentence each, measured suite counts, the release-history row, the downgrade posture, min_manager_version equal to the CI pin, a 2.20.0 class in the release tests
